title: GPU Reserve Thumbwheel: Compact Health Strips & Burst Thumbwheel Controls
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a compact, operator-friendly UI component set for Dedicated capacity pages that surfaces per-pool health signals and lets operators tune burst and autoscale via a tactile ‘thumbwheel’ control pattern. This ticket covers wireframes, a high-fidelity prototype, accessibility checks, and a short interaction spec for handoff to engineering. The component should work in constrained dashboard real estate and adapt between a compact row entry and an expanded detail drawer.
acceptance_criteria: Compact health strip component with CPU/GPU utilization sparkline, heat indicator, and recent error badge implemented in Figma
Thumbwheel control prototype allowing 0-100% burst allocation with step presets (10%, 25%, 50%) and a hysteresis toggle
Interaction spec describing keyboard accessibility, screen-reader labels, and focus states
PM and Eng sign-off on visual spec and interaction patterns, linked PR created for engineering implementation
Usability test with 5 operators showing median task success and no major confusion for burst allocation flow
notes: Design must balance density and legibility: default compact row should show only key signals, expand to drawer for full telemetry
Thumbwheel is a visual metaphor for fine-grained burst control; fallback is a numeric input for keyboard users
Will reuse existing color tokens and KPI microcards from Console design system to minimize engineering overhead
Constraint: dedicated pool rows can appear in long lists; avoid high-cost animations and prefer lightweight SVG sparklines
Accessibility: ensure aria-live updates for health status changes and provide text alternatives for color-only indicators
decisions: Use a horizontal thumbwheel with discrete ticks (0/10/25/50/100) rather than continuous free drag to reduce accidental misconfigurations
Show burst budget as both absolute GPU-minutes and percentage to surface cost implications
Health strip will aggregate node-level thermals into a single banded indicator (OK/Warn/Critical) with tooltip drilldown
Autoscale controls kept separate from thumbwheel; autoscale toggle exposes policy presets (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive)
review_comments: PM (Jordan Lee): Prefer explicit confirmation for >50% burst changes to prevent runaway costs
Engineering (Priya Anand): Need API contract for burst: /pools/:id/burst {target_pct, budget_minutes, effective_until}. Also ask for rate-limit semantics
Design review (Samir Cho): Suggest micro-animations on tick snap to clarify discrete steps; keep them subtle
Security (Maya Collins): Confirm audit-event emission for manual burst adjustments (will add to eng tickets if accepted)
next_steps: Incorporate PM feedback: add optional confirmation modal for large burst allocations
Update prototype with keyboard numeric input fallback and aria-labels
Create ENG implementation ticket with API contract and attach Figma assets (ENG-8210)
Schedule 30m handoff with backend and frontend engineers the week of 2025-03-03
